projects.title: Frame-Level Speech Recognition
projects.description: Worked with MFCC data consisting of 28 features at each time step/frame. My deep learning model was able to recognize the phoneme that occurred in each frame with 86.2% validation accuracy on Kaggle. Also developed a custom torch library (mytorch) from scratch for this project.

projects.title: Inferring Customer Locations Using Synthetic Call Detail Records
projects.description: Used big data frameworks like PySpark to infer customer call locations from call detail records, as part of a Mobile Big Data Analytics class project with Togo as the case study. Combined Python, pandas, and geopandas with PySpark for parallel processing.

projects.title: Customer Segmentation and Churn Prediction
projects.description: Applied machine learning to two business challenges: grouping customers by purchasing patterns and demographics using K-means clustering, and predicting customer churn with Random Forest and Logistic Regression, surfacing insights for targeted marketing and retention.

projects.title: Data Classification Using Large Language Models
projects.description: Built a solution to classify large volumes of unstructured text into predefined categories by fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs such as GPT-3 and BERT. Used Hugging Face's Transformers and PyTorch, applying tokenization and attention mechanisms to boost accuracy.

projects.title: Web Scraping and Sentiment Analysis
projects.description: Integrated web scraping and sentiment analysis using Object-Oriented Programming principles to extract, process, and interpret data from web sources, aiming for reusable, modular, and scalable code for data collection.

projects.title: Land Use Land Cover Change Study Using Deep Learning
projects.description: Used deep learning to classify Land Use Land Cover (LULC) for environmental monitoring and land management, building and training models with TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch to accurately classify land cover types from remote sensing data.

projects.title: Predictive Analytics
projects.description: Explored predictive modeling on classic datasets — Titanic survival data and Wine Quality — applying applied machine learning techniques to uncover patterns and evaluate model performance.
